name: Heavy Five
source:
In the not so distant future, mankind has finally cracked the secret of faster than light travel and, with the population of Earth reaching crisis levels, has set forth to explore, find and colonise new worlds for humanity by sending forth deep space vessels.

You are a engineering officer aboard one of these deep space vessels. The Intrepid, which is currently engaged on a series of resupply missions for those tenuous outposts humanity has so far been able to establish. Relaxing off duty, you find yourself hastily ordered as a last minute replacement for an injured crew member on a mission to resupply a science station on the planet Ophion which has been experiencing a series of unusual events...
translation:
在不远的将来，人类终于破解了超光速旅行的秘密，随着地球人口达到危机水平，人类开始通过发射深空飞船来探索、寻找和殖民新世界。

你是其中一艘深空飞船上的工程官员。无畏号目前正在进行一系列补给任务，为人类迄今为止能够建立的那些脆弱的前哨基地进行补给。下班后放松一下，你发现自己被匆忙命令在最后一刻接替一名受伤的船员，执行一项任务，为俄菲翁星球上的一个科学站提供补给，该站正在经历一系列不寻常的事件……
